text: TPC's average STATUTORY tariff rate uses FIXED 2025 import-volume weights and EXCLUDES AD/CVD; MFN base rates sit inside the 'Other' type. Our current counterpart is the ex-post collections rate on contemporaneous weights, which includes AD/CVD collections and reflects import contraction; the constructs are not directly comparable. Same-construct replication (our rates x fixed 2025 weights, ex-AD/CVD) is the planned stage-1 counterpart and requires an AD/CVD exclusion list consistent with theirs.
basis: TPC chart notes (aO4iG v44, MC81F v43), fetched 2026-08-08

text: The TPC Tariff Rules Engine is closed source; construct fidelity is testable only against published chart granularity, and divergences stay author-attributed with our derivation recorded.
